authorReviewNote: NPC expansion accepted as non-player character; non-playable is also valid but deliberately absent from other options. Invented alternative expansions do not overlap. Sony actual glossary inspected; ignored its overly restrictive non-combative claim. Original dictionary URL had no relevant entry, replaced.

Downloadable content is Steamworks documentation heading and expansion. Dictionary DLC was unrelated financial abbreviation, rejected. Other offered expansions not established game meaning. Clear gaming context, grammar correct.

HP can mean health or hit points, explicitly both accepted together. Other options measure network, distance and frame rate. Sony glossary actual HP paragraph checked. Not saying every game uses identical damage systems.
XP experience points in levelling context, not alternative invented expansions. Sony actual XP entry checked. Avoided claiming all RPG progression requires XP.

FPS performance display measures frames per second. Context excludes equally real first-person-shooter genre abbreviation. Files, fights and friends are not frame-rate units. Actual dictionary definition inspected.

RPG role-playing game, not other offered invented expansions. Dedicated RPG dictionary source replaces possibly tabletop-only full-term definitions; Sony actual RPG expansion also corroborated. Game genre context clear.

MMO expansion massively multiplayer online, first part of MMORPG. Other invented acronym expansions wrong. Actual dictionary MMORPG full form checked. Does not assert all MMO games are RPGs or require subscription.

Changed from ambiguous shared-goal alternatives: turn-taking could also be cooperative. Now asks co-op's cooperative expansion, with three distinct words; only one correct. Actual dictionary gaming definition and abbreviated cooperative form inspected.

Cross-play connects supported platforms. Cross-progression distractor concerns transferring saves, turn-taking local mode and autoplay do not define cross-play. Actual dictionary gaming definition inspected. Supported qualification avoids universal platform promise.

Checkpoint resumes near recent progress after failure. Other software operations not restart points. Replaced police-border-only dictionary source with indexed actual Xbox game manual passage. Direct PDF fetch failed, not represented as full reading.

Respawn reappearance after defeat. Progress deletion, chapter advance and download update different. Actual dictionary gaming sense includes character reappearing. Usually question avoids claims every game has revival.

Tutorial teaches controls/mechanics. Credits, match highlights and automatic graphics adjustment do not serve that main purpose. Replaced absurd finance/advertising choices with game features. Dictionary instructional sense inspected.

Open world relatively free exploration. Linear-only levels, spectator mode and a timed-race-only competition do not define it. Actual gaming adjective definition checked. Relatively permits locked regions/tutorial restrictions, not universal freedom.

Save file stores game state/progress. Microphone recording, installers list and screenshot are different file contents. Xbox indexed manual explicitly resumes saved game; generic computing-save definition also checked. Replaced irrelevant controller condition/purchase receipt options.

Autosave automatic game progress recording. Photo mode, fast travel and split-screen are other features. Nintendo Bravely Default manual indexed actual text explicitly contrasts automatic saving after events; no assumption all titles enable it by default.

Mod modification changes/adds content. Subscription, button layout and earned rank do not define software modification. Actual dictionary gaming sense checked. Did not restrict authorship to fans; official mods also possible.

Purely cosmetic intended appearance change, not damage, health or access to levels. Actual adjective sense appearance without basic change checked. Intended qualification avoids claims every implemented cosmetic is guaranteed bug-free or mechanically identical.

Emote expressive avatar animation. Attack stat, map download and difficulty setting do not fit. Generic emotion dictionary inadequate; Minecraft official patch notes explicitly emote animations and wheel inspected instead. Usually permits stationary gestures and dances.

Quest log tasks/objectives. Graphics settings, online friends and installed updates are different menus. Replaced generic search definition and absurd electricity/screws distractors. Blizzard actual starter guide explicitly quest log/story/objectives/progress, inspected; no current-keybinding trivia.

Split-screen separate player views one display. Hot-seat, streamed spectating and save transfer distinct. Nintendo Wave Race manual indexed actual text explicitly top half P1/bottom P2 and split-screen layout. Replaced empty dictionary entry. Does not confuse all local co-op with split-screen.
